markdown:
# Setup script reference



Setup scripts are now covered in [Project scripts](/docs/reference/scripts#setup-scripts).

Use a setup script when a new workspace needs commands, generated files, symlinks, or workspace-specific resources. Configure it with `scripts.setup` in `.conductor/settings.toml`, or open [`Settings`](https://app.conductor.build/settings/repos?section=scripts), select the project, and edit the setup script.

For static gitignored files such as `.env.local`, use [Files to copy](/docs/reference/files-to-copy) instead.
